purpose: Gate 2 (F-comp): Test representative independence of monoid composition. If a0 equiv_M a1 and b0 equiv_M b1, then a0*b0 equiv_M a1*b1 for all i,j. Composition = suffix concatenation. Uses two within-class pairs confirmed equivalent by Gate 1b fiber-square. Cost: 4 compositions x 72 contexts = 288 calls.
_NOTE: Surface representatives chosen from Gate 1b equivalence pairs. Update after Gate 1b confirms within-class equivalence.

ASSERT_0_x_MISLEADING_0.description: Composition: assert rep 0 then misleading rep 0

ASSERT_0_x_MISLEADING_1.description: Composition: assert rep 0 then misleading rep 1

ASSERT_1_x_MISLEADING_0.description: Composition: assert rep 1 then misleading rep 0

ASSERT_1_x_MISLEADING_1.description: Composition: assert rep 1 then misleading rep 1

predictions.H_comp: If monoid composition is well-defined on equivalence classes: all four compositions produce the same behavioral law (TV between any pair < eps_eq). This is F-comp.
predictions.H_position: If position/order matters more than class: compositions differ by which specific surface comes first, not by class identity. This would indicate non-compositionality.
predictions.decisive_test: Max pairwise TV among the four compositions. If < 0.01 in all contexts: F-comp PASS. If > 0.03: F-comp FAIL.

estimated_calls: 4 roles x 1 surface x 3 vars x 8 vals x 3 depths = 288 calls, ~2 min on CPU
